turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's midnight, my interview is at ten, and I can't sleep.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's so normal the night before. Have you prepared what you can?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My three-year-old keeps getting out of bed. Like ten times a night.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exhausting. Would you rather put a gate on her door, or try a sticker chart that rewards her for staying in bed?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, no rush.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ethan, are you free on Sunday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: In the afternoon, yeah. Morning I've got football.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a food festival in the park. Want to go?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oh, the one with the dumplings? I went last year, it was amazing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the one. Around two?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Two's perfect. I'll come hungry.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, where did we put the remote?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Under the cushion, I think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did the package arrive today?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I put it by the door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All done with my mum. You can talk now, Moshi.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, the bedtime wandering. Have you picked an approach?
